{{Top|leg}}
A '''Repulsor Sensor''',<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref> also known as a '''repulsor-field sensor''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] designed to detect a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] field. [[XG Anti-Gravity Field Bomb]]s utilized Repulsor Sensors to detect vehicle repulsorlift fields,<ref name="CRFG" /> as did the [[3HX3 timer mine]].<ref name="EGWT" /> Once detected, it detonated the [[Mine/Legends|mine]].<ref name="CRFG" />
